Subject: Access controls — day-zero ops & provisioning summary

Hi Sarah,

Thanks for the kickoff earlier. Per our call, here's a concise day-zero access plan so your SRE and security teams can provision and validate before go-live.

Attachments: edgehealth-access-checklist.xlsx (stub)

Key items (short):
- SSO/SAML: we'll provide metadata XML and ACS/EntityID endpoints. You'll provide your IdP metadata and SAML test user.
- SCIM: API token-based SCIM provisioning. We need these attributes: email, displayName, title, department. SCIM will be disabled initially; enable after pilot.
- IP allowlist: we'll need a /24 CIDR for your testing region and a separate production CIDR. Temporary staging IPs allowed for a 72-hour window.
- Service accounts: list service account names and intended scopes (recommended least privilege). We'll create service principals in the tenant and produce credential rotation notes.
- Org policies: recommended defaults attached in checklist (2FA, session timeout 12h, data retention 30d).

Requested next steps:
1) Confirm IdP contact + test user by EOD Thu (2025-12-04)
2) Share procurement contact for SCIM token approval (we've included procurement@edgehealth.com in reply)
3) Provide test/staging IPs for allowlist

I'll schedule a 30-min technical handoff this week if that helps.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Customer Enablement | Redwood Inference

--

Hi Sarah / team,

I'll own the implementation sequencing. Proposed Mutual Action Plan (MVP):
- D0: Exchange SAML metadata + validate test user (owner: EdgeHealth IdP)
- D1: Enable IP allowlist for staging CIDR + smoke test (owner: EdgeHealth DevOps)
- D2: SCIM token issuance and initial sync in dry-run mode (owner: Procurement + Redwood)
- D3: Service-account provisioning and access validation (owner: EdgeHealth + Redwood)
- D7: Pilot traffic cutover to verify telemetry and token rotation

Attachments: redwood-map-v1.pdf (MVP map)

Notes on service account model:
- We support short-lived OAuth tokens via our token service; SCIM uses a long-lived token for provisioning but keys can be rotated via API. We'll default to a 30-day rotation cadence.
- Dept -> Team mapping: we can map freeform 'department' strings to team tags; Monica will share a simple mapping CSV after you send the department list.

I'll run the technical handoff meeting on 2025-12-02 10:00 PT; calendar invite to follow. Can you confirm Tom & DevOps attend?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
